messages:
maria_cs: Quick follow-up on BrightWell — we had 3 repeat 503s this week during their heavy ingest window. bringing this into the weekly health check thread :wave:

olivia_success: Ugh, saw that in the dashboard. Increased error rate from 0.2% -> 2.1% for the 12:00-13:30 window. Any correlation to deployment? :eyes:

maria_cs: Timed with the model swap to redwood-v2-quant. Spike lined up with a cache warm-up storm. Logged one customer stack trace where the client retried rapidly and we hit a batching overflow.

incident_bot: Incident alert (BrightWell): 3x 503s detected between 2026-03-18T12:05Z and 2026-03-18T13:28Z. Suspected path: batch overflow + KV mismatch. Ticket: CW-4791.

dan_engineer: I looked at the traces — there's a pattern: frequent short requests with small token counts but high concurrency. Our batching window expanded and the kv-cache lookup fell back to cold path. Likely cause: model variant changed cache keying.

kevin_se: Can we confirm if customer pins a model version? BrightWell is on hosted with auto-upgrade off. They pinned to redwood-v2-quant last week during onboarding.

maria_cs: They did pin. They reported retries from their side after 503s. We promised a follow-up with a timeline and owners.

dan_engineer: Proposed immediate actions:
- revert fallback to pre-swap batching policy for BrightWell route (config flag)
- add cache-key compatibility check to rollout job
- add heartbeat metric for kv-cache miss spikes

kevin_se: Assign owners?

maria_cs: I'll own customer comms and timeline. @dan_engineer take the revert and metric (P0), @oncall_sre take the cache-key compatibility check (P1). Olivia, can you confirm whether this impacts billing/credits?

olivia_success: Will check billing impact. If we do config revert for BrightWell only it's low cost; I'll confirm by EOD.

dan_engineer: On it. Revert deployed to staging. Plan to roll to BrightWell route tonight at 02:00 UTC behind a canary. I'll post the deploy job snippet in case you want to review:

```bash
# canary deploy to route brightwell
redwood deploy --route brightwell --model redwood-v2-quant --batching-policy pre-swap --canary 5%
```

oncall_sre: I'll run the compatibility check script and attach results. If there's any mismatch we'll block further auto-rollouts for that model until we patch.

maria_cs: Timeline & comms plan:
- Today EOD: confirm billing (Olivia) + confirm canary time (Dan)
- Tonight 02:00 UTC: canary revert to pre-swap batching on BrightWell route (Dan)
- Tomorrow morning: monitor errors for 6h, if <0.5% we lift and send customer note (Maria)
- CW-4791: leave open until post-monitoring review and KB entry

kevin_se: Can we add owner for KB write-up? I can help draft the explanation for customers (root cause + mitigation).

maria_cs: Kevin — assigned KB draft. Add the example logs and explain retry behavior + suggested client backoff.

dan_engineer: Quick log snippet I pulled from the trace: 

```
[2026-03-18T12:06:22Z] request id=abc123 route=brightwell tokens=8 concurrent=24 backend=redwood-v2-quant result=503 reason=batching_overflow
[2026-03-18T12:06:22Z] retry id=abc123-1 client_retry=true
[2026-03-18T12:06:23Z] request id=def456 route=brightwell tokens=6 concurrent=26 backend=fallback result=200
```

maria_cs: Good. I'll update the customer after canary completes. We'll ask them to keep retries capped and implement exponential backoff per the KB once published.

olivia_success: Billing: confirmed low impact if we do route-specific revert. No credits needed. I'll update the BrightWell account notes.

incident_bot: CW-4791 updated: owner=dan_engineer; sla=72h; status=in-progress.

dan_engineer: Canary scheduled and started. Posting results in ~30m.

maria_cs: Thanks, team. Please add any follow-ups here. I'll close the loop in tomorrow's health sync with BrightWell. :thumbsup:

kevin_se: Added KB draft checklist to CW-4791.

oncall_sre: Compatibility check complete — one mismatch flagged (kv-key-v2 vs kv-key-v1) on 3 model shards. Raised PR to add compatibility shim.

dan_engineer: Canary looks good so far: error rate normalized to 0.15% on the canary cohort. Rolling to 100% in 20m if stable.

maria_cs: Perfect, I'll schedule the customer update for 09:30 their local time tomorrow.

olivia_success: Noted. Closing action items for billing.

maria_cs: Closing notes for this thread: owners assigned = [maria_cs: comms, dan_engineer: revert & metrics, oncall_sre: compatibility check, kevin_se: KB draft, olivia_success: billing]. Re-open CW-4791 if anything regresses.

kevin_se: Thanks all. :pray:
